item.title: Youbaku Kitan Crisis
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Ura Pirochaki
  • 発売日: 2022-06-08
  • スコア: なし
  • 日本語名: 妖縛奇譚CRISIS
  • 英語名: Youbaku Kitan Crisis

あらすじ

Hideji immediately realized that the girl who appeared in the village was Misuzu, who had moved to another town long ago. Misuzu says she is fed up with life in the city, has run away from home, and plans to stay in the village for a while. Although Hideji senses something unsettling about Misuzu’s demeanor, he is so elated by their reunion that he is persuaded to promise to keep her runaway status a secret.

item.title: Shokushu-kun F
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Ura Pirochaki
  • 発売日: 2019-03-08
  • スコア: なし
  • 日本語名: 触手くんF
  • 英語名: Shokushu-kun F

あらすじ

Long ago, when tentacled creatures appeared in the city, it became public knowledge that some humans had these creatures as ancestors.

People called them “Anothers” and shunned them, believing they had been lurking in the shadows of history. However, since Anothers were indistinguishable from humans and impossible to identify, there was no open conflict; instead, their presence was met with latent loathing and fear.

あらすじ

A slime-like creature that lived in secret by the water, feeding on grass seeds, frogs, and lizards.

That is you.

One day, after coming into contact with a dead man’s body by the water’s edge, you acquire enough intelligence to converse with humans.

Furthermore, upon discovering that you can evolve by attacking human women and using their bodies, you are reborn as a tentacled creature. Driven from the waters, you roam the city and begin attacking girls, but…

  • 日本語名: 妖縛奇譚アポカリプス
  • 英語名: Youbaku Kitan Apocalypsis

あらすじ

Aya Nagaoka, a psychic girl who came to the village to perform an exorcism, and Kunihiko Nishina, a reporter who came to cover the exorcism.

Every night, the two of them have the same dream.

…In it, Kunihiko continuously rapes Aya in an abandoned house.

As the day of the exorcism approaches, Aya grows increasingly exhausted.

item.title: Kanaami -Osananajimi Ami no Baai-
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Ura Pirochaki
  • 発売日: 2015-07-28
  • スコア: なし (2 人評価)
  • 日本語名: カナアミ -幼馴染 愛海の場合-
  • 英語名: Kanaami -Osananajimi Ami no Baai-

あらすじ

The childhood friend confessed her love to the protagonist.

Both believe they’re fated to be together, but that means something different to him.

Disappointed and trembling, the friend is violated in captivity.

It’s not an act of cruelty or revenge in his mind… it’s an act of love.

This is how the twisted protagonist knows how to express himself.
